name: Gohmann Supply, LLC
old_description: GOHMANN SUPPLY, LLC is a family owned and operated company founded in 2009 by Chris & Heather Gohmann.
about:
Gohmann Supply, LLC is a family-owned business founded in 2009 by Chris and Heather Gohmann in St. Cloud, Minnesota. Chris Gohmann brought seven years of hands-on experience from a central Minnesota meat market, where he worked from kill-floor cleanup to retail sales, before joining a national manufacturing firm as a service technician, technical trainer, and regional sales consultant for the Southwest U.S. His enduring passion for meat processing led the couple to establish their own supply company.

The company operates as a distributor of food processing equipment and supplies, offering both new and pre-owned machinery alongside consumable items such as trolleys, gambrels, and rail components. Gohmann Supply represents multiple equipment brands and emphasizes responsive service and technical support, drawing on Chris Gohmann’s background in equipment service and training. The business runs from a facility at 23784 67th Avenue in St. Cloud.

Primary customers are meat and food processors ranging from small local operations to larger regional plants. The firm’s mission statement underscores a focus on providing quality equipment and supplies backed by industry-leading service and support to this sector.

The venture was born from Chris Gohmann’s desire to stay connected to the meat-processing trade after years in corporate roles, aiming to combine better brand selection with personalized service that puts the customer first.
